Filed: 2026-09-24 · Status: citation pack v1 · Evidence classes used: ATTESTED · PRIMARY ESSAY · MIDRASH/ORAL · SERIOUS HYPOTHESIS · STAGING
What this pack is

This is the wire beneath the shelf volumes: every claim a visitor can touch on the clay vessel (A-04), the scorched pole (A-03), the grove-burn plaque (A-10), and the sand urn is listed with its evidence class and its source. Hard rules honored: no invented DOIs or page numbers, no invented Library essay bodies, no collapsing Genesis 11 into historical linguistics, no promoting debated readings into settled fact.
Source filing references (Drive) are held in the council wire, not printed on this public page.
Source ledger

External attested anchors: Nature 2025 Takarkori genomes (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08793-7). Biblical references cited by verse only (Deut 16:21; 2 Kgs 23:6–7; Gen 11) — text tradition, not archaeological proof of every narrative detail.
